description: Pressure Drop Estimation in Pipelines using Darcy–Weisbach equation with analytical modeling and multi-software validation (MATLAB, Python, Excel, Aspen HYSYS & DWSIM).
AI-assisted Aspen HYSYS skill for existing-case parameter takeover, validation, and reporting.
Python scripts for creating, opening, and modifying Aspen HYSYS case files through the COM interface.
A Python-based interface for Aspen HYSYS enabling automated heat exchanger network (HEN) supertargeting to pre-identify the optimal ΔTmin.
Radial Basis Function (RBF) interpolation framework for thermodynamically consistent data generation from Aspen HYSYS simulations of atmospheric distillation units processing multi-crude blends.

Steady-state simulation of a natural gas sweetening unit using DEA solvent in Aspen HYSYS V14. Models full absorption-regeneration loop. >99.9% H₂S removal. Complete stream tables, column profiles, and energy analysis included.

Steady-state simulation of an Atmospheric Crude Distillation Unit (CDU) processing Arabian Light crude using Aspen HYSYS V14. Includes pump-around circuit design and a heat integration study achieving a 53.6% reduction in furnace duty through Pinch Analysis principles.
